name: B10-0390/2025 (ESN) – Case of Victoire Ingabire in Rwanda
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the case of Victoire Ingabire in Rwanda
part_text:
The European Parliament is calling for fair and open trials in Rwanda after the arrest of opposition leader Victoire Ingabire and other party members in 2025. It asks Rwanda's government to talk with all opposition parties and let them take part in political life. It also welcomes Rwanda's offer to take in rejected asylum seekers and wants the European Union to negotiate sending some to Rwanda too. The text is a statement of the Parliament's views, not a change in law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet; Parliament only states its views and requests.
- **Who it affects:** Rwanda's government and opposition, and asylum seekers.
- **What happens next:** The resolution is sent to EU bodies and Rwanda's government.
